authority: User-adopted AUTORUN_REQUEST.ko.md §8 scoped read/review delegation; parent bounded task
verdict: Two narrow technical clarifications should close before complete P2G-20 publication. No concrete material policy ambiguity or acceptance change established. Design is implementable in a bounded atomic phase subject to those clarifications and explicit GEX obligations; no implementation success is certified.

findings.title: Separate mandatory admission/receipt/fuel from optional trace
findings.problem: P05 correctly prohibits gameplay abort on trace collection overflow, but P04 stages observation/receipt caps and P05 then rejects receipt hard-limit violations. Without an explicit partition, adding trace rows to the receipt can make trace-on exceed the hard cap and roll back a step while trace-off commits. Optional observer work charged against gameplay execution fuel can cause the same problem. The phrase same admitted execution does not by itself prove equal admission for an otherwise identical request.
findings.minimal_fix: State that mandatory gameplay result/binding documents and their deterministic admission budget are independent of trace. Optional trace has a separate bounded allowance, fixed bounded coverage metadata, and overflow/observer limitations have an observational disposition. Optional trace cannot consume mandatory receipt allowance or gameplay fuel, alter binding input documents, or change step publication. Preserve P04 rollback for genuine mandatory request/receipt errors. Add an at-cap test where trace-on overflows while trace-off does not and compare commit disposition, continuation and RNG.
basis: world/application.rs152–161,182–215 establishes authoritative commit and infallible publication
battle/event_log.rs616–643 and751–756 shows existing observational eviction and skipped source memory

findings.title: Install control before generated setup/startup, including load-time route
findings.problem: Current startup begins before world active-session installation: events/combat.rs129–205 builds/validates scenario, constructs BattleCore and calls start_battle_execution at197–198. sim.rs1783–1817 validates, clones/places obstacles, builds runtime field and enqueues scenario events. This path also executes inside content_pack::load generated setup validation before any CoreApplication exists. A control installed only on active battle or subsequent time-zero/clock draft misses actual reachable setup work. Candidate intent includes time-zero preparation but needs this earlier source seam and load path made explicit.
findings.minimal_fix: Add the exact load→generated-validation→setup/start and trial-preparation source chain to Current Actual and P06. Require authoring opt-in control or a source-backed bounded argument for this direct generated validation/startup route, with pre-allocation/expansion checks and load-stage cancellation/error propagation. Control must start before construction/start and not share mutable counters with A. Include low-fuel/cancel during generated setup and during valid-token trial startup; keep their phases distinct. Do not claim complete R23 protection.

findings.title: Outer candidate needs private opaque fork/staging ownership
findings.problem: CoreApplication currently owns private GameCore and has no Clone or public mutable inner port. The proposed outer candidate is implementable inside the crate but is not an already callable public capability. The inner prepared commit owns only state/run_seed/game_data/output; added control/observation ownership cannot be assumed to follow it automatically.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep exact private fork/stage/control/result plumbing an explicit GEX obligation. Preserve external privacy; compare complete authority including UUID/RNG, token, profile, receipt and quota across rejection. No public raw GameCore/BattleCore escape or active-run checkpoint substitution. Candidate already states the ownership invariant; this is a handoff reminder, not a reason to return to P2G-10.

acceptance_coverage.assessment: Public external loader and command route exists; generic facade/CLI and nonzero scenario remain proposed.
EFFECT_SUPPORT literal editability is separated from wider executor vocabulary; explicit finite observed bindings avoid content dispatch.
Same shared envelope is proposed, with producer-owned codes/phases; not current API/CLI parity proof.
Real available source preserved with unknown precision explicit; generated/startup phase control needs DR02 clarification.
Actual public battle preparation and nonzero external effect delta is mandatory; existing battle probe alone does not satisfy.
Explicit initial authority/seed/content/templates/resolved clocks/occurrences; DR01 closes optional-trace admission coupling.
Readonly projection plus identical deterministic continuation verifies no state/RNG/revision mutation.
Exact winner/effect source and compiled identities proposed; absent spans/derived chains are not fabricated.
B requires actual battle entry/time-zero or verified immediately terminal battle identity before one aggregate swap.
Invalid load and valid-token failed prep preserve complete A repeatedly; low-fuel/setup boundary added by DR02.
Finite strict request/expansion/work/queue/output caps and typed rejection are required; numbers remain measured implementation decisions.
Owned DTOs and last-reference release, ephemeral tool state, V6/profile/public contracts retained; no personal files or new midbattle save.
Actual hashes/toolchain/workload/nonzero execution and failure receipts mandatory; no runtime work executed in this design review.
